content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to display temperature using the trend view component in [product_name]. After selecting my variable from the dropdown, I can't set the signed format or decimal places. I see the message 'reference global tag cannot be modified.' In the global tag table, it's also not possible to set signed/unsigned formats or decimal places. Has anyone dealt with this? Thank you!

When displaying variables with decimal places in Trend View, avoid defining them as global variables. Instead, add them as 'PrivateTag' in the Trend View Variable Table, which allows for decimal places to be selected. Note that decimal places might not display later when you review this table.
Thank you for your help! I am still a bit confused, though, since each time I add a variable, the decimal settings reset. If I use a private tag, I notice I can't name the trend.
Exactly, private tags can't have names, and global tags can't assign decimal places. In my opinion, this is a significant issue in [product_name].
Should I submit a report about this, or has it already been reported? Thanks!
I'm not sure if anyone has reported it yet, but I haven't.
Alright, I’ll submit a request about it. Thank you for your assistance!
I experienced a similar situation as described here. Thank you for highlighting this important detail!
Two years later, this issue still remains? I am facing the same problem.
"I have the same problem" isn’t a helpful error report. Please provide a precise description and include screenshots.
If you are experiencing exactly the same issue, then it still isn’t fixed. The latest version [version_no] released in August 2022 still has this problem.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report ongoing frustration with the Trend View feature in [product_name], especially regarding display of temperature values. The main issue is the inability to set decimal places or signed/unsigned formats for global tags, whereas private tags allow decimal customization but cannot be named, which limits trend identification. The system message 'reference global tag cannot be modified' adds to confusion, forcing users to choose between incomplete formatting and unclear labeling, resulting in usability challenges.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect full control over decimal places and signed/unsigned formatting for all tags, especially global ones, and want to be able to name trends for better identification.
